dataset.title: Degradation path indicators for lithium-ion batteries

chronology.v343: INCONCLUSIVE because a per-cycle capacity field was absent; no outcome accessed
chronology.v347: INCONCLUSIVE because one development cell did not cover the whitespace-delimited header family; F0002 charge-only fields were parsed, no capacity accessed, no prediction output written
chronology.header_inventory_scope: 47 confirmation archives, header line only, zero data rows

schema_and_target.cycle_discharge_capacity_rule: within each cycle, sum max(Ah[j-1]-Ah[j],0) over consecutive finite rows j with I[j] below -1e-5 A
schema_and_target.target: cycle discharge capacity divided by the median capacity of the first five structurally eligible cycles

prediction_contract.charge_definition: first contiguous positive-current block within cycle that covers 600 seconds

confirmatory_statistics.primary_metric: cell-equal mean of within-cell MAE(PCHP)-MAE(protected baseline)

decision_gates.execution: at least 36 eligible cells; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
decision_gates.mean_effect: cell-equal mean PCHP-minus-baseline MAE below zero
decision_gates.win_fraction: at least two thirds of non-tied cells improve
decision_gates.harm_contract: maximum pointwise displacement, observed absolute-loss regret, and cell-macro harm each at most 0.01 plus 1e-12
decision_gates.decision: RETAIN only when execution and every scientific gate pass; otherwise REJECT

stop_rule: No outcome-responsive changes to the 47-cell roster, complete header family, time conversion, capacity recovery rule, source model, window, anchor, alphas, harm budget, aggregation, uncertainty unit, or gates.
